behavior.arguments: rdi and rsi are the only arguments read; both are tested for zero and both feed the two leas; no other argument is read
behavior.branch_order: first je at body offset 7 skips the subtract lea when rdi is zero; second je at body offset 17 skips the fall-through ret (whose rax already holds rdi+rsi-0xc) when rsi is zero; both land on the sum lea; no calls inside the window
behavior.output_shape: rax is fully determined (lea in both return paths, mod 2^64): rdi+rsi when either argument is zero, else rdi+rsi-0xc

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase
